name: 内部占用和成本分配 (5VZ)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item is only relevant for the Integration with SAP Cloud for Real Estate.

After you group Real Estate Objects (Buildings, Floors, Spaces, Land, Land Areas) in the Group Real Estate Object for Occupancy SAP Fiori app, you can manage and maintain within the Manage Occupancy of Real Estate Object SAP Fiori app the Occupancy Groups.

In internal occupancy and cost allocation, you can maintain occupancy rates in Enable Use Groups, assign occupancy cost center, and perform the Periodic Posting for internal cost allocation. A contract creation is not required.

Key Process Flow

  • Open Enable Real Estate Object for Use (F5465) app
  • Search for building or land to be assigned internally and object type
  • Enable object group with object category of internal with condition type, unit price, calculation formula, and measurement type
  • Search for building or land to be leased out externally by company code and object type
  • Create object group with internal object category
  • Perform periodic processing for internal occupancy

Business Benefits

  • Use a single repository for all real estate assets in the entire portfolio independent of back-end system
  • Collect costs by real estate location, supporting financial reporting and location analysis
  • View vacancy/occupancy reporting for each location based on space type
  • See what fixed assets are used to support each enabled object
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目仅与与 SAP Cloud for Real Estate 集成相关。

在分组要占用的不动产对象 SAP Fiori 应用中对不动产对象（建筑物、楼层、空间、土地、土地范围）进行分组后，您可以在管理不动产对象的占用 SAP Fiori 应用中管理和维护占用组。

在内部占用和成本分配中，您可以在启用使用组中维护占用率、分配占用成本中心并为内部成本分配执行定期过账。不需要创建合同。

关键流程流

  • 打开启用不动产对象 (F5465) 应用
  • 搜索要内部分配的建筑物或土地，以及对象类型
  • 使用条件类型、单价、计算公式和度量类型启用对象类别为内部的对象组
  • 按公司代码和对象类型搜索要在外部租出的建筑物或土地。
  • 创建具有内部对象类别的对象组
  • 对内部占用执行定期处理

业务优势

  • 独立于后端系统，为整个投资组合中的所有不动产资产使用单一资源库
  • 按不动产位置收集成本，支持财务报告和位置分析
  • 根据空间类型查看每个位置的空缺/占用报告
  • 查看用于支持每个已启用对象的固定资产。
